create_ArgillaLogger: create an ArgillaLogger instance to send LLM logs to Argilla for annotation
log_success_event: log a successful LLM completion event to Argilla with batched queue flushing
async_log_success_event: async log a successful LLM completion event to Argilla with dataset_hook callbacks
async_log_failure_event: async log a failed LLM event to Argilla with sampling rate filtering
_prepare_log_data: transform a standard logging payload into Argilla item format with configurable field mapping
